text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad we had a nice shopping 
trip—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that took more time than I 
expected. I should head back quickly and 
prepare for training—oh?”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
What they're doing over there... could it 
be—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! It's a flower photography 
exhibition—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah... What a vivid, lush, and lively 
photograph this isâ

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Cornflowers next to a rose garden... It's 
a combination I hadn't really thought of 
before, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It's truly lovely... Maybe someday, I 
could arrange them into a bouquet—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this photo too— It's amazing... I 
guess I still have so much more to 
learn...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Completely captivated by the photos, 
Curren Bouquetd'or ended up skipping her 
training.
